reason: I've been burned by a fake agency and ghosted on payment before, so a brand-new beta app from a small team asking me to connect my Instagram is a no for now. My WhatsApp groups already send me barter leads for free, so I don't need to take the risk.
objection: Giving an app access to my Instagram feels risky, and I have no idea who is behind Mitra or whether the 'brands' on it are real and actually pay.
would_change_my_mind: Someone in my creator WhatsApp groups I trust saying they got an actual paid collab through Mitra, and got paid on time, without anything bad happening to their account.
